long_biography.plain_text:
Classic motoring is the most visible thread in Wael M. Buheiry's public life. In Dubai, he displayed a Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Gullwing and a Jaguar XK120, explaining that sculptural beauty guided his collecting choices. The Jaguar later became the first car in the United Arab Emirates to receive a FIVA identity passport.

Buheiry's collection has also appeared internationally. A Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Roadster entered under his name won the post-war open-car class at the Uniques concours. He extended the interest into publishing with Rouge: A Classic Journey through Jordan, an automotive travel book linking historic cars with Jordanian roads and landscapes. His business career and the source and structure of his wealth remain private.
